Subject: Intro & demo: Redwood inference for Crescent Labs

Hi Olivia —

Thanks again for taking a few minutes with Marissa last week. We’d love to run a short (30–40m) demo of Redwood Inference focused on how teams like yours reduce per-token costs and keep latency stable during peak loads.

Proposed agenda (attached):
- 5m intros & goals
- 10m architecture & runtime highlights (dedicated vs private options)
- 15m live demo (streaming, routing, cost controls)
- 10m Q&A + next steps

Are any of these slots workable for your team next week?
- Tue 1/20 — 11:00–11:40 AM ET
- Wed 1/21 — 2:00–2:40 PM ET
- Thu 1/22 — 9:00–9:40 AM ET

If those don’t fit, happy to propose alternatives. Attaching the demo agenda and a brief case study about a healthcare customer with similar compliance needs.

Thanks,
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.com | (415) 555-0142

Hi Sean —

Appreciate the outreach and the clear agenda. I wanted to let you know we’re pausing the inference POC for now. Two things came up on our side: the ML infra lead is on a two-week field deployment starting next week (travel), and we just got a directive to hold on non-core projects while we finish a hiring freeze review for Q1.

Given that, we won’t be able to commit to a demo next week. Procurement is also juggling a couple of higher-priority contracts right now (procurement@crescentlabs.com copied for visibility).

That said, this is still on our radar — I expect we’ll re-evaluate in Q2 once the hiring review clears. Could we plan a light check-in in mid-April? If you have any short-written materials or a 5–7 slide one-pager on cost/lifecycle impact you can send over, that would be helpful to keep this warm.

Best,
Olivia Park
Head of ML Ops | Crescent Labs
olivia.park@crescentlabs.com
